main_text.p: Argos hîc cognominatur, Lyncei filius eft, & pater Talai à quo natus eft Adraftus, qui Argos incoluit, Argiuorum & Sycionorum rex.

Χαίρων ὃ ἡ αὐτὸς.) Scholion verba ait esse victoris, quodque vsus sit Aristomenes oraculo Alcmanis de futura victoria, eiusque domui coniunctum fuisse Alcmanis facellum. Verùm puto poëtæ esse verba, breuiter laudantis heroa Alcmanem: nam & coronare ipsum & aspergere hymno ait, quod non est Aristomanis, sed poëtæ officium.

Τίτων ὅτι μοι.) Ratio poëtæ, cur & hunc celebret, quia vicinus mihi. 2. patronus fortunarum mearum, forte Thebis cultus est. 3. Delphos euntì successum debitum occurrit. 4. Artes vatidicas mihi communicauit, aut in me oraculi sui certitudinem confirmauit.
main_text.head: Strophe 4. versuum 9.
main_text.p: ORationem ad Apollinem conuertit, duas Aristomenis victorias illi acceptas ferens, commendaturus illi poëticen suam & fortunas victoris.

Τὸ ἐκατηβόλε.) Inuocatio poëtæ ad Apollinem κατ' ἐπιμβολὼ. Templum Apollinis Delphicum παντόξιον dicitur, quia aduenas quoscunque admittat. Apollo ἑκατηβόλος dicitur, procul iaculàs, quod ad radios solares transfert Macrobius. est idem epitheton etiam Musis tributum suprà in 9. Olymp. Strophe 1. ἀλλὰ νῦν ἑκατηβόλων μοῖσαν ὑπὸ τόξων.
Τὸ μὴν μέγιστον.) Victoriam praesentem Pythicam Apollini tanquam autori acceptam refert.

Οἴκοι ὃ παρόδεν.) Altera victoria Aristomenis quam in Ægina obtinuit: coluère hîpræcipuè Apollinè & Mincruâ. ac in Apollinis gratiam instituti erant ludi Delphinia dicti, qui constabant quinquercio. in his vicit, antequam ad Pythica proficisceretur spectacula. ὑμῶν pro σῶς tuis: Apollinis enim festum erat.
Ἑνόντ' ἀλ' εὐχομαι.) Propositionem subiunctúrus δύχω explicat.
main_text.head: Antistrophe 4. versuum 9.
main_text.p: DVo commendat Apollini, suos hymnos & fortunas Aristomenis. inde longiùs digreditur in vulgi iudicium

page.notes: Greek passages are only approximately set in this transcription; the Greek type is worn and several words are doubtful and should be checked against the scan. Lines of the Greek at the start of notes, and the Greek in the Strophe glosses, are not reliable. The first word of the Greek note "Τοιαῦτα μὴν" and the marginal Greek lines are marked by the scan only partially. Some printed spellings (e.g. "s" forms, "Scholion") are kept as printed where legible. The closing initials "T.J." are printed at the foot of the text.
